answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with a slow-release reward. To join the garden of trusted agents, each identity must lock a refundable deposit that only unlocks after a long history of useful work. A new agent entering through the inlet starts with zero reputation and earns only small tasks, so a sybil operator must fund thousands of deposits at once. Like a reef built coral by coral, reputation accrues gradually and cannot be bought in bulk; misbehavior slashes the deposit and wipes the accumulated score, making the attack cost far more than any reward it could extract.
